description: $trial and $position are built-in variables (runtime-design §7a), but osp-survey/0.1 identifiers cannot start with '$', so a label piping ${$trial} is an error (pipe.invalid). The survey leaves it out; the traces record the values in steps[].builtins instead.

notExpressible.why: pipe.invalid: '$trial' is not an identifier; the model has no built-in variable namespace

item.label: Trial ${$trial}, stimulus ${$position.index} of ${$position.of}: rate it from 1 to 9.
